calls.title: GrowthBook Demo for Infinite Locus
calls.summary: The meeting focused on Infinite Locus assessing GrowthBook as a suitable A/B testing platform for their diverse clients, including those in e-commerce, sports, and nutraceutical sectors. With clients averaging one experiment per week, there is potential for rapid adoption, particularly with 1-2 clients ready to start soon. GrowthBook's features, such as supporting over 2,800 companies and having a flexible, warehouse-native architecture, were emphasized. The discussion also covered GrowthBook's new pricing structure, limiting experiments, and the anticipated integration of AI technologies. The meeting concluded with plans for follow-up materials and immediate client deployments framed around the Pro tier capabilities.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, A/B Testing, Conversion Rate Optimization, Visual Editor, Data Warehouse, Experimentation Platform
